reading: ONE training request, chosen as arm A's first row and therefore a training row of both arms. It is in NEITHER the sealed fourteen nor the eval pack's sixty-four — asserted by the producer — so a reply to it is not an eval output and the one attempt is not spent by seeing it. The attempt is SPENT at the first GOLD-row reply generated
